headline.zh: 資管所碩士班・斐闊 Finctory 共同創辦人暨技術長
headline.en: M.S. student, Information Management · Co-founder & CTO, Finctory

bio.zh: 中央資管碩士班學生（2026 年 9 月起），學士班 GPA 4.19／4.3 畢業。斐闊 Finctory 共同創辦人暨技術長、醫數行銷 MedaLink 共同創辦人暨前線部署工程師、工研院產科國際所 AI Intern。在邱信瑜老師指導下做了兩個國科會大專生計畫：結合股市異常指標與生成式 AI 的股票追蹤系統，以及財伴 oSave 個人財務健康管理系統的實證研究。累計 16 項競賽獎，其中 5 座全國首獎。
bio.en: M.S. student in Information Management at NCU from September 2026, after a B.S. with a 4.19/4.3 GPA. Co-founder and CTO of Finctory, co-founder and forward-deployed engineer at MedaLink, and AI intern at ITRI's ISTI. Under Prof. Hsin-Yu Chiu he ran two NSTC undergraduate projects: a stock tracking system combining market-anomaly indicators with generative AI, and an empirical study of oSave, a personal financial-health app. 16 competition awards, 5 of them national first prizes.
